propositions: CREATE emit of a non-epic parent to a bound child does not record a bridge alert when the hierarchy guard drops the parent, leaving only an unobserved logger.debug line
ACLI attach fallback swallows HTTP 400 from set_parent with only a WARNING log and no durable record, unlike the identical divergence path in dispatch_one that records outbound-parent-rejected

UPDATE emit path established a contract via pass_io.py and dispatch_one.py that outbound parents failing to reach the tracker must leave a bridge_alerts entry, not a log line; two of four surfaces still violate it

The epic-only parent guard is unconditional but documented only as a Cloud next-gen constraint; Data Center has different behavior (accepts and ignores instead of rejecting) so the rationale must be clarified in docs and code comments to match implementation

A keyword-only suppressed_out parameter must thread through OutboundMapper to report which parents were dropped by the 8b25 guard, enabling the CREATE and UPDATE callers to judge convergence and emit bridge alerts accordingly

An unbound parent (not yet synced to Jira) must remain silent during the guard to avoid alerting on divergence that converges on a later pass, preserving the bound/unbound distinction established by ticket 9f26
